themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: CoreWeave's Q3 revenue rose 168% to $3.661 billion, above the $3.55 billion forecast, and it raised 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0 to $13.3 billion; customers prepaid about $9 billion, but quarterly interest hit $846 million (company release; CNBC). Contracted power passed 4.6 GW. CRWV traded up about 15% before the open on Nov 11 (CNBC).
themes.for_you: Demand for AI compute is still rising, which supports the chain's suppliers. CRWV has no usable verdict ('Not enough data'); do not chase the gap. APH, still in its buy zone at 79.95, gets the read across.

themes.name: AI power and the grid
themes.what: Siemens Energy posted record fiscal Q4 revenue of 12.83 billion euros, up 21.5%, with orders of 14.8 billion euros and up to 9 billion euros of new buybacks through 2030; its CEO said he has no doubt more US data centers will be built (CNBC, Nov 11). SoftBank booked a 597.2 billion yen loss tied to changing plans for power equipment it had bought ahead for US AI data centers (CNBC).
themes.for_you: Gas turbine and grid demand is holding. GEV fell 3.89% to 797.04 on Nov 10 (Massive) and is left out of both lists: SoftBank's write down shows some buyers over ordered, which could free up turbine slots later. No power setups or puts today.

themes.name: Fintech and Crypto Rails: Stablecoins, Tokenization, Exchanges
themes.what: NYSE picked Avalanche to run clearing and settlement for its planned 24/7 tokenized stock platform, pending regulatory approval, targeted before the end of 2026 (Wall Street Journal via Yahoo Finance). ICE rose 1.34% to 176.36 on Nov 10 (Massive). A Galaxy Digital director also bought about $70,000 at $13.98, filed Nov 10, joining the CEO's $9.86 million buy (dashboard).
themes.for_you: Tokenized trading is moving into the main exchanges, which favors ICE over pure crypto names. GLXY is left out of both lists: the insider cluster is real, but the group is still falling. No fintech puts: RELY's put did not trade on Nov 10.

themes.name: GLP-1 and obesity
themes.what: Hims and Hers fell another 16.61% to 19.13 on Nov 10 on 58.8 million shares, the day after its third 2026 guidance cut (Massive; KoalaGains). It is down about 44% this year (StockStory).
themes.for_you: Two heavy volume down days in a row is distribution. HIMS stays 'Wait'; no puts. Telehealth GLP-1 access is getting more crowded as LLY and NVO sell direct.

themes.name: Space, Quantum and Cyber: Government Funded Frontier Tech
themes.what: Rocket Lab rose 6.54% to 62.71 on Nov 10 on 32.1 million shares (Massive) while ARK bought about 54,600 shares (ARK). The Space Development Agency gave SpaceX a $9.9 million study of its laser terminals for missile tracking satellites (Defence Blog). No FAA license for Starship Flight 15 was posted as of Nov 10 (Teslarati).
themes.for_you: RKLB is 'Avoid' on valuation, so the volume is not a buy signal. SPCX trades the Starship window on Friday Nov 13; no setup.

innovations.name: Energy
innovations.what: Rotation check. Fervo's Q3 (Nov 9): first 33 MW Cape Station block in commercial operation and a new Google power deal that lifts binding contracts to 1,054 MW, about $11.9 billion, from 658 MW; revenue was only $116,000 and cash is $1.9 billion. NuScale's Q3 revenue was $0.3 million with no binding TVA deal yet, and Oklo's loss was narrower than forecast. No stage moves: geothermal stays early adoption and SMRs stay pilot.
innovations.for_you: No action. FRVO (11.38 on Nov 10), OKLO (25.09) and SMR (5.22) are not on any buy list (Massive). SMR and OKLO are left out of both lists: cash is ample, but revenue and binding deals are still missing.

countries.name: European Union
countries.what: European chip stocks rose on Nov 11 after CoreWeave's results: Infineon +6.3%, ASMI +5.5%, STMicro +4% and ASML about +3% (CNBC). Siemens Energy posted record quarterly revenue of 12.83 billion euros, while Vestas fell 9.2% on a miss (CNBC).
countries.for_you: No action. ASML is in the AI compute and defense themes but has no buy verdict.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Correction: Brent's dip under $90 on Nov 10 was intraday; it settled at $91.49, down 1.17% (NDTV Profit). On Nov 11 it rose 1.4% to $92.81 by 8:14am ET after Iran's security chief said enriched nuclear material will not leave the country; 37 ships were attacked in Hormuz in October, the most since the war began (Reuters).
countries.for_you: Left out of both lists: oil is bouncing today but is down about 21% this month. No energy setups or puts.

countries.name: Japan
countries.what: The Nikkei 225 rose 1.31% to 61,248.59 on Nov 11 (CNBC). SoftBank fell 3% after a fiscal Q2 net loss of 1.12 trillion yen (about $7 billion), including losses tied to US AI data center power equipment and Intel shares (CNBC).
countries.for_you: No action. SoftBank is the biggest Japanese bet on US AI spending, and its loss shows the cost of buying ahead.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.what: The KOSPI rose 2.6% to 5,375.36 on Nov 11 and the Kosdaq 5.62%, led by SK hynix (+5.36%) and Samsung (+3.57%) after CoreWeave's beat (CNBC). In New York on Nov 10, EWY fell 2.05% to 139.18 (Massive).
countries.for_you: Memory names bounce hardest on AI demand news. No Korea trades; EWY is not on any list.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.what: TSMC's board approved up to $500 million of Anthropic shares at the IPO price and up to $500 million of OpenAI preferred stock (TSMC, Nov 10); TSMC's Taipei shares rose 2.19% on Nov 11 (CNBC). The TSM ADR closed 396.48 on Nov 10, up 2.02% (Massive).
countries.for_you: TSM is #1 on the Lineup but has no buy verdict. Buying stakes in its two biggest AI customers ties TSMC closer to their fortunes. No action.
